name: 0A001
description: "Nuclear reactors" and specially designed or prepared equipment and components therefor, as follows:

name: 0A001.a.
description: "Nuclear reactors";

name: 0A001.b.
description: Metal vessels, or major shop-fabricated parts therefor, including the reactor vessel head for a reactor pressure vessel, specially designed or prepared to contain the core of a "nuclear reactor";

name: 0A001.c.
description: Manipulative equipment specially designed or prepared for inserting or removing fuel in a "nuclear reactor";

name: 0A001.d.
description: Control rods specially designed or prepared for the control of the fission process in a "nuclear reactor", support or suspension structures therefor, rod drive mechanisms and rod guide tubes;

name: 0A001.e.
description: Pressure tubes specially designed or prepared to contain both fuel elements and the primary coolant in a "nuclear reactor";

name: 0A001.f.
description: Zirconium metal tubes or zirconium alloy tubes (or assembles of tubes) specially designed or prepared for use as fuel cladding in a "nuclear reactor", and in quantities exceeding 10 kg;

name: 0A001.g.
description: Coolant pumps or circulators specially designed or prepared for circulating the primary coolant of "nuclear reactors";

name: 0A001.h.
description: ‘Nuclear reactor internals’ specially designed or prepared for use in a "nuclear reactor", including support columns for the core, fuel channels, calandria tubes, thermal shields, baffles, core grid plates, and diffuser plates;

name: 0A001.i.
description: Heat exchangers as follows:

name: 0A001.i.1
description: Steam generators specially designed or prepared for the primary, or intermediate, coolant circuit of a "nuclear reactor";

name: 0A001.i.2
description: Other heat exchangers specially designed or prepared for use in the primary coolant circuit of a "nuclear reactor";

name: 0A001.j.
description: Neutron detectors specially designed or prepared for determining neutron flux levels within the core of a "nuclear reactor";

name: 0A001.k.
description: ‘External thermal shields’ specially designed or prepared for use in a "nuclear reactor" for the reduction of heat loss and also for the containment vessel protection.

name: 0B

name: 0B001
description: Plant for the separation of isotopes of "natural uranium", "depleted uranium" or "special fissile materials", and specially designed or prepared equipment and components therefor, as follows:

name: 0B001.a.
description: Plant specially designed for separating isotopes of "natural uranium", "depleted uranium", or "special fissile materials", as follows:

name: 0B001.a.1.
description: Gas centrifuge separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.2.
description: Gaseous diffusion separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.3.
description: Aerodynamic separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.4.
description: Chemical exchange separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.5.
description: Ion-exchange separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.6.
description: Atomic vapour "laser" isotope separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.7.
description: Molecular "laser" isotope separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.8.
description: Plasma separation plant;

name: 0B001.a.9.
description: Electro magnetic separation plant;

name: 0B001.b.
description: Gas centrifuges and assemblies and components, specially designed or prepared for gas centrifuge separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.b.1.
description: Gas centrifuges;

name: 0B001.b.2.
description: Complete rotor assemblies;

name: 0B001.b.3.
description: Rotor tube cylinders with a wall thickness of 12 mm or less, a diameter of between 75 mm and 650 mm, made from ‘high strength-to-density ratio materials’;

name: 0B001.b.4.
description: Rings or bellows with a wall thickness of 3 mm or less and a diameter of between 75 mm and 650 mm and designed to give local support to a rotor tube or to join a number together, made from ‘high strength-to-density ratio materials’;

name: 0B001.b.5.
description: Baffles of between 75 mm and 650 mm diameter for mounting inside a rotor tube, made from ‘high strength-to-density ratio materials’;

name: 0B001.b.6.
description: Top or bottom caps of between 75 mm and 650 mm diameter to fit the ends of a rotor tube, made from ‘high strength-to-density ratio materials’;

name: 0B001.b.7.
description: Magnetic suspension bearings as follows:

name: 0B001.b.7.a.
description: Bearing assemblies consisting of an annular magnet suspended within a housing made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6" containing a damping medium and having the magnet coupling with a pole piece or second magnet fitted to the top cap of the rotor;

name: 0B001.b.7.b.
description: Active magnetic bearings specially designed or prepared for use with gas centrifuges;

name: 0B001.b.8.
description: Specially prepared bearings comprising a pivot-cup assembly mounted on a damper;

name: 0B001.b.9.
description: Molecular pumps comprised of cylinders having internally machined or extruded helical grooves and internally machined bores;

name: 0B001.b.10.
description: Ring-shaped motor stators for multiphase AC hysteresis (or reluctance) motors for synchronous operation within a vacuum at a frequency of 600 Hz or more and a power of 40 VA or more;

name: 0B001.b.11.
description: Centrifuge housing/recipients to contain the rotor tube assembly of a gas centrifuge, consisting of a rigid cylinder of wall thickness up to 30 mm with precision machined ends that are parallel to each other and perpendicular to the cylinder’s longitudinal axis to within 0,05° or less;

name: 0B001.b.12.
description: Scoops consisting of specially designed or prepared tubes for the extraction of UF6 gas from within the rotor tube by a Pitot tube action and capable of being fixed to the central gas extraction system;

name: 0B001.b.13.
description: Frequency changers (converters or inverters) specially designed or prepared to supply motor stators for gas centrifuge enrichment, having all of the following characteristics, and specially designed components therefor: a. A multiphase frequency output of 600 Hz or greater; and b. High stability (with frequency control better than 0,2 %);

name: 0B001.b.14.
description: Shut-off and control valves as follows:

name: 0B001.b.14.a.
description: Shut-off valves specially designed or prepared to act on the feed, product or tails UF6 gaseous streams of an individual gas centrifuge;

name: 0B001.b.14.b.
description: Bellows-sealed valves, shut-off or control, made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6", with an inside diameter of 10 mm to 160 mm, specially designed or prepared for use in main or auxiliary systems of gas centrifuge enrichment plants;

name: 0B001.c.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for gaseous diffusion separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.c.1.
description: Gaseous diffusion barriers made of porous metallic, polymer or ceramic "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6" with a pore size of 10 to 100 nm, a thickness of 5 mm or less, and, for tubular forms, a diameter of 25 mm or less;

name: 0B001.c.2.
description: Gaseous diffuser housings made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6";

name: 0B001.c.3.
description: Compressors or gas blowers with a suction volume capacity of 1 m^3/min or more of UF6, with a discharge pressure up to 500 kPa, and having a pressure ratio of 10:1 or less, and made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6";

name: 0B001.c.4.
description: Rotary shaft seals for compressors or blowers specified in 0B001.c.3. and designed for a buffer gas in-leakage rate of less than 1 000 cm^3/min.;

name: 0B001.c.5.
description: Heat exchangers made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6", and designed for a leakage pressure rate of less than 10 Pa per hour under a pressure differential of 100 kPa;

name: 0B001.c.6.
description: Bellows-sealed valves, manual or automated, shut-off or control, made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6";

name: 0B001.d.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for aerodynamic separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.d.1.
description: Separation nozzles consisting of slit-shaped, curved channels having a radius of curvature less than 1 mm, resistant to corrosion by UF6, and having a knife-edge contained within the nozzle which separates the gas flowing through the nozzle into two streams;

name: 0B001.d.2.
description: Cylindrical or conical tubes, (vortex tubes), made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6" and with one or more tangential inlets;

name: 0B001.d.3.
description: Compressors or gas blowers made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6", and rotary shaft seals therefor;

name: 0B001.d.4.
description: Heat exchangers made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6";

name: 0B001.d.5.
description: Separation element housings, made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6" to contain vortex tubes or separation nozzles;

name: 0B001.d.6.
description: Bellows-sealed valves, manual or automated, shut-off or control, made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6", with a diameter of 40 mm or more;

name: 0B001.d.7.
description: Process systems for separating UF6 from carrier gas (hydrogen or helium) to 1 ppm UF6 content or less, including:

name: 0B001.d.7.a.
description: Cryogenic heat exchangers and cryoseparators capable of temperatures of 153 K (– 120°C) or less;

name: 0B001.d.7.b.
description: Cryogenic refrigeration units capable of temperatures of 153 K (– 120 °C) or less;

name: 0B001.d.7.c.
description: Separation nozzle or vortex tube units for the separation of UF6 from carrier gas;

name: 0B001.d.7.d.
description: UF6 cold traps capable of freezing out UF6;

name: 0B001.e.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for chemical exchange separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.e.1.
description: Fast-exchange liquid-liquid pulse columns with stage residence time of 30 s or less and resistant to concentrated hydrochloric acid (e.g. made of or protected by suitable plastic materials such as fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers or glass);

name: 0B001.e.2.
description: Fast-exchange liquid-liquid centrifugal contactors with stage residence time of 30 s or less and resistant to concentrated hydrochloric acid (e.g. made of or protected by suitable plastic materials such as fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers or glass);

name: 0B001.e.3.
description: Electrochemical reduction cells resistant to concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions, for reduction of uranium from one valence state to another;

name: 0B001.e.4.
description: Electrochemical reduction cells feed equipment to take U^+4 from the organic stream and, for those parts in contact with the process stream, made of or protected by suitable materials (e.g. glass, fluorocarbon polymers, polyphenyl sulphate, polyether sulfone and resin-impregnated graphite);

name: 0B001.e.5.
description: Feed preparation systems for producing high purity uranium chloride solution consisting of dissolution, solvent extraction and/or ion exchange equipment for purification and electrolytic cells for reducing the uranium U^+6 or U^+4 to U^+3;

name: 0B001.e.6.
description: Uranium oxidation systems for oxidation of U^+3 to U^+4;

name: 0B001.f.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for ion-exchange separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.f.1.
description: Fast reacting ion-exchange resins, pellicular or porous macro-reticulated resins in which the active chemical exchange groups are limited to a coating on the surface of an inactive porous support structure, and other composite structures in any suitable form, including particles or fibres, with diameters of 0,2 mm or less, resistant to concentrated hydrochloric acid and designed to have an exchange rate half-time of less than 10 s and capable of operating at temperatures in the range of 373 K (100 °C) to 473 K (200 °C);

name: 0B001.f.2.
description: Ion exchange columns (cylindrical) with a diameter greater than 1 000 mm, made of or protected by materials resistant to concentrated hydrochloric acid (e.g. titanium or fluorocarbon plastics) and capable of operating at temperatures in the range of 373 K (100 °C) to 473 K (200 °C) and pressures above 0,7 MPa;

name: 0B001.f.3.
description: Ion exchange reflux systems (chemical or electrochemical oxidation or reduction systems) for regeneration of the chemical reducing or oxidizing agents used in ion exchange enrichment cascades;

name: 0B001.g.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for laser-based separation processes using atomic vapour laser isotope separation, as follows:

name: 0B001.g.1.
description: Uranium metal vaporization systems designed to achieve a delivered power of 1 kW or more on the target for use in laser enrichment;

name: 0B001.g.2.
description: Liquid or vapour uranium metal handling systems specially designed or prepared for handling molten uranium, molten uranium alloys or uranium metal vapour for use in laser enrichment, and specially designed components therefor;

name: 0B001.g.3.
description: Product and tails collector assemblies for collecting uranium metal in liquid or solid form, made of or protected by materials resistant to the heat and corrosion of uranium metal vapour or liquid, such as yttria-coated graphite or tantalum;

name: 0B001.g.4.
description: Separator module housings (cylindrical or rectangular vessels) for containing the uranium metal vapour source, the electron beam gun and the product and tails collectors;

name: 0B001.g.5.
description: "Lasers" or "laser" systems specially designed or prepared for the separation of uranium isotopes with a spectrum frequency stabilisation for operation over extended periods of time;

name: 0B001.h.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for laser-based separation processes using molecular laser isotope separation, as follows:

name: 0B001.h.1.
description: Supersonic expansion nozzles for cooling mixtures of UF6 and carrier gas to 150 K (– 123 °C) or less and made from "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6";

name: 0B001.h.2.
description: Product or tails collector components or devices specially designed or prepared for collecting uranium material or uranium tails material following illumination with laser light, made of "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6";

name: 0B001.h.3.
description: Compressors made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6", and rotary shaft seals therefor;

name: 0B001.h.4.
description: Equipment for fluorinating UF5 (solid) to UF6 (gas);

name: 0B001.h.5.
description: Process systems for separating UF6 from carrier gas (e.g. nitrogen, argon or other gas) including:

name: 0B001.h.5.a.
description: Cryogenic heat exchangers and cryoseparators capable of temperatures of 153 K (– 120 °C) or less;

name: 0B001.h.5.b.
description: Cryogenic refrigeration units capable of temperatures of 153 K (– 120 °C) or less;

name: 0B001.h.5.c.
description: UF6 cold traps capable of freezing out UF6;

name: 0B001.h.6.
description: "Lasers" or "laser" systems specially designed or prepared for the separation of uranium isotopes with a spectrum frequency stabilisation for operation over extended periods of time;

name: 0B001.i.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for plasma separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.i.1.
description: Microwave power sources and antennae for producing or accelerating ions, with an output frequency greater than 30 GHz and mean power output greater than 50 kW;

name: 0B001.i.2.
description: Radio frequency ion excitation coils for frequencies of more than 100 kHz and capable of handling more than 40 kW mean power;

name: 0B001.i.3.
description: Uranium plasma generation systems;

name: 0B001.i.4.
description: Not used;

name: 0B001.i.5.
description: Product and tails collector assemblies for uranium metal in solid form, made of or protected by materials resistant to the heat and corrosion of uranium vapour such as yttria-coated graphite or tantalum;

name: 0B001.i.6.
description: Separator module housings (cylindrical) for containing the uranium plasma source, radio-frequency drive coil and the product and tails collectors and made of a suitable non-magnetic material (e.g. stainless steel);

name: 0B001.j.
description: Equipment and components, specially designed or prepared for electromagnetic separation process, as follows:

name: 0B001.j.1.
description: Ion sources, single or multiple, consisting of a vapour source, ioniser, and beam accelerator made of suitable non-magnetic materials (e.g. graphite, stainless steel, or copper) and capable of providing a total ion beam current of 50 mA or greater;

name: 0B001.j.2.
description: Ion collector plates for collection of enriched or depleted uranium ion beams, consisting of two or more slits and pockets and made of suitable non-magnetic materials (e.g. graphite or stainless steel);

name: 0B001.j.3.
description: Vacuum housings for uranium electromagnetic separators made of non-magnetic materials (e.g. stainless steel) and designed to operate at pressures of 0,1 Pa or lower;

name: 0B001.j.4.
description: Magnet pole pieces with a diameter greater than 2 m;

name: 0B001.j.5.
description: High voltage power supplies for ion sources, having all of the following characteristics: a. Capable of continuous operation; b. Output voltage of 20 000 V or greater; c. Output current of 1 A or greater; and d. Voltage regulation of better than 0,01 % over a period of 8 hours;

name: 0B001.j.6.
description: Magnet power supplies (high power, direct current) having all of the following characteristics: a. Capable of continuous operation with a current output of 500 A or greater at a voltage of 100 V or greater; and b. Current or voltage regulation better than 0,01 % over a period of 8 hours.

name: 0B002
description: Specially designed or prepared auxiliary systems, equipment and components as follows, for isotope separation plant specified in 0B001, made of or protected by "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6":

name: 0B002.a.
description: Feed autoclaves, ovens or systems used for passing UF6 to the enrichment process;

name: 0B002.b.
description: Desublimers or cold traps, used to remove UF6 from the enrichment process for subsequent transfer upon heating;

name: 0B002.c.
description: Product and tails stations for transferring UF6 into containers;

name: 0B002.d.
description: Liquefaction or solidification stations used to remove UF6 from the enrichment process by compressing, cooling and converting UF6 to a liquid or solid form;

name: 0B002.e.
description: Piping systems and header systems specially designed or prepared for handling UF6 within gaseous diffusion, centrifuge or aerodynamic cascades;

name: 0B002.f.
description: Vacuum systems and pumps as follows:

name: 0B002.f.1.
description: Vacuum manifolds, vacuum headers or vacuum pumps having a suction capacity of 5 m^3/minute or more;

name: 0B002.f.2.
description: Vacuum pumps specially designed for use in UF6 bearing atmospheres made of, or protected by, "materials resistant to corrosion by UF6"; or

name: 0B002.f.3.
description: Vacuum systems consisting of vacuum manifolds, vacuum headers and vacuum pumps, and designed for service in UF6-bearing atmospheres;

name: 0B002.g.
description: UF6 mass spectrometers/ion sources capable of taking on-line samples from UF6 gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater and having a resolution of better than 1 part in 320; 2. Ion sources constructed of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys with a nickel content of 60 % or more by weight, or nickel-chrome alloys; 3. Electron bombardment ionisation sources; and 4. Having a collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

name: 0B003
description: Plant for the conversion of uranium and equipment specially designed or prepared therefor, as follows:

name: 0B003.a.
description: Systems for the conversion of uranium ore concentrates to UO3;

name: 0B003.b.
description: Systems for the conversion of UO3 to UF6;

name: 0B003.c.
description: Systems for the conversion of UO3 to UO2;

name: 0B003.d.
description: Systems for the conversion of UO2 to UF4;

name: 0B003.i.
description: Systems for the conversion of UO2 to UCl4.

name: 0B004
description: Plant for the production or concentration of heavy water, deuterium and deuterium compounds and specially designed or prepared equipment and components therefor, as follows:

name: 0B004.a.
description: Plant for the production of heavy water, deuterium or deuterium compounds, as follows:

name: 0B004.a.1.
description: Water-hydrogen sulphide exchange plants;

name: 0B004.a.2.
description: Ammonia-hydrogen exchange plants;

name: 0B004.a.3.
description: Combined  Electrolysis and Catalytic Exchange (CECE) plants;

name: 0B004.a.4.
description: Combined Industrial Reforming and Catalytic Exchange (CIRCE) plants;

name: 0B004.a.5.
description: Bithermal Hydrogen-Water exchange (BHW) plants;

name: 0B004.b.

name: 0B004.b.1.
description: Water-hydrogen sulphide exchange towers with diameters of 1,5 m or more, capable of operating at pressures greater than or equal to 2 MPa;

name: 0B004.b.2.
description: Single stage, low head (i.e., 0,2 MPa) centrifugal blowers or compressors for hydrogen sulphide gas circulation (i.e., gas containing more than 70 % by weight hydrogen sulphide, H2S) with a throughput capacity greater than or equal to 5 m^3/s when operating at pressures greater than or equal to 1,8 MPa suction and having seals designed for wet H2S service;

name: 0B004.b.3.
description: Ammonia-hydrogen exchange towers greater than or equal to 35 m in height with diameters of 1,5 m or greater capable of operating at pressures greater than 15 MPa;

name: 0B004.b.4.
description: Tower internals, including stage contactors, and stage pumps, including those which are submersible, for heavy water production utilising the ammonia-hydrogen exchange process;

name: 0B004.b.5.
description: Ammonia crackers with operating pressures greater than or equal to 3 MPa for heavy water production utilising the ammonia-hydrogen exchange process;

name: 0B004.b.6.
description: Not used;

name: 0B004.b.7.
description: Catalytic burners for the conversion of enriched deuterium gas into heavy water utilising the ammonia-hydrogen exchange process;

name: 0B004.b.8.
description: Complete heavy water finishing  units, upgrade systems, or columns with diameters of 0.1 m or greater therefor, for the upgrade of heavy water to reactor-grade deuterium concentration

name: 0B004.b.9.
description: Ammonia synthesis converters or synthesis units specially designed or prepared for heavy water production utilising the ammonia-hydrogen exchange process.

name: 0B004.b.10.
description: Complete columns  or towers specially designed or prepared for hydrogen isotope exchange having all of the following: 1. Packed with random or structured wet-proofed platinised catalysts; 2. Constructed of carbon steel or stainless steel; 3. Capable of operating with pressure in the range of 0.1 to 4 MPa; and 4. Capable of operating at temperatures in the range of 293 K (20°C) to 473 K (200°C).

description: Chemical warfare (CW) agents; or

description: "Riot control agents", including:

description: α-Bromobenzeneacetonitrile, (Bromobenzyl cyanide) (CA) (CAS 5798-79-8);

description: [(2-Chlorophenyl) methylene] propanedinitrile, (o-Chlorobenzylidenemalononitrile) (CS) (CAS 2698-41-1);

description: 2-Chloro-1-phenylethanone, Phenylacyl chloride (ω-chloroacetophenone) (CN) (CAS 532-27-4);

description: Hard body armour plates providing ballistic protection equal to or less than level IIIA (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008), or "equivalent standards".

name: 1A006.a.
description: Remotely operated vehicles;

name: 1A006.b.
description: ‘Disruptors’.

description: Equipment and devices, specially designed to initiate charges and devices containing "energetic materials", by electrical means, as follows:

description: Explosive detonator firing sets designed to drive explosive detonators specified in 1A007.b.;

name: 1A007.b.
description: Electrically driven explosive detonators as follows:

name: 1A007.b.1.
description: Exploding bridge (EB);

name: 1A007.b.2.
description: Exploding bridge wire (EBW);

name: 1A007.b.3.
description: Slapper;

name: 1A007.b.4.
description: Exploding foil initiators (EFI).

description: Charges, devices and components, as follows:

name: 1A008.a.
description: ‘Shaped charges’ having all of the following: 1. Net Explosive Quantity (NEQ) greater than 90 g; and 2. Outer casing diameter equal to or greater than 75 mm;

name: 1A008.b.
description: Linear shaped cutting charges having all of the following, and specially designed components therefor: 1. An explosive load greater than 40 g/m; and 2. A width of 10 mm or more;

name: 1A008.d.

An inside diameter of between 75 mm and 650 mm;  b. A thickness of 12 mm or less; and c. Made with any of the "fibrous or filamentary materials" specified in 1C010.a. or b. or 1C210.a. or with carbon prepreg materials specified in 1C210.c.

name: 1A225
description: Wet-proofed platinized catalysts specially designed or prepared for promoting the hydrogen isotope exchange reaction between hydrogen and water for the recovery of tritium from water or for the production or upgrading of heavy water.

name: 1B
description: Test, Inspection and Production Equipment

name: 1B001
description: Equipment designed for the "production" of "composite" structures or laminates or "fibrous or filamentary materials", as follows, and specially designed components and accessories therefor:

name: 1B001.a.
description: Filament winding machines, of which the motions for positioning, wrapping and winding fibres are coordinated and programmed in three or more ‘primary servo positioning’ axes, specially designed for the manufacture of "composite" structures or laminates, from "fibrous or filamentary materials";

name: 1B001.b.
description: ‘Tape-laying machines’, of which the motions for positioning and laying tape are coordinated and programmed in five or more ‘primary servo positioning’ axes, specially designed for the manufacture of "composite" airframe or ‘missile’ structures;

name: 1B001.c.
description: Multidirectional, multidimensional weaving machines or interlacing machines, including adapters and modification kits, specially designed or modified for weaving, interlacing or braiding fibres, for "composite" structures;

name: 1B001.d.
description: Equipment specially designed or modified for the "production" of "fibrous or filamentary materials" specified by 1C010, as follows:

name: 1B001.d.1.
description: Equipment for converting polymeric fibres (such as polyacrylonitrile, rayon, pitch or polycarbosilane) into carbon fibres or silicon carbide fibres, including special equipment to strain the fibre during heating;

name: 1B001.d.2.
description: Equipment for the chemical vapour deposition of elements or compounds, on heated filamentary substrates, to manufacture silicon carbide fibres;

name: 1B001.d.3.
description: Equipment for the wet-spinning of refractory ceramics (such as aluminium oxide);

name: 1B001.d.4.
description: Equipment for converting aluminium containing precursor fibres into alumina fibres by heat treatment;

name: 1B001.e.
description: Equipment specially designed or modified for the production of prepregs by the "hot melt method";

name: 1B001.f.
description: Non-destructive inspection equipment specially designed for "composite" materials, as follows:

name: 1B001.f.1.
description: X-ray tomography systems for three dimensional defect inspection;

name: 1B001.f.2.
description: Numerically controlled ultrasonic testing machines of which the motions for positioning transmitters or receivers are simultaneously coordinated and programmed in four or more axes to follow the three dimensional contours of the component under inspection;

name: 1B001.g.
description: ‘Tow-placement machines’, of which the motions for positioning and laying tows are coordinated and programmed in two or more ‘primary servo positioning’ axes, specially designed for the manufacture of "composite" airframe or ‘missile’ structures.

name: 1B002
description: Equipment designed to produce metal alloy powder or particulate materials, and having all of the following: a. Specially designed to avoid contamination; and b. Specially designed for use in one of the processes specified in 1C002.c.2.

name: 1B003
description: Tools, dies, moulds or fixtures, for "superplastic forming" or "diffusion bonding" titanium, aluminium or their alloys, specially designed for the manufacture of any of the following:

name: 1B003.a.
description: Airframe or aerospace structures;

name: 1B003.b.
description: "Aircraft" or aerospace engines; or

name: 1B003.c.
description: Specially designed components for structures specified in 1B003.a. or for engines specified in 1B003.b.

name: 1B101
description: Equipment, other than that specified in 1B001, for the "production" of structural composites as follows; and specially designed components and accessories therefor:

name: 1B101.a.
description: Filament winding machines or fibre placement machines, of which the motions for positioning, wrapping and winding fibres can be coordinated and programmed in three or more axes, designed to fabricate composite structures or laminates from "fibrous or filamentary materials", and coordinating and programming controls;

name: 1B101.b.
description: Tape-laying machines of which the motions for positioning and laying tape and sheets can be coordinated and programmed in two or more axes, designed for the manufacture of composite airframe and "missile" structures;

name: 1B101.c.
description: Equipment designed or modified for the "production" of "fibrous or filamentary materials" as follows:

name: 1B101.c.1.
description: Equipment for converting polymeric fibres (such as polyacrylonitrile, rayon or polycarbosilane) including special provision to strain the fibre during heating;

name: 1B101.c.2.
description: Equipment for the vapour deposition of elements or compounds on heated filament substrates;

name: 1B101.c.3.
description: Equipment for the wet-spinning of refractory ceramics (such as aluminium oxide);

name: 1B101.d.
description: Equipment designed or modified for special fibre surface treatment or for producing prepregs and preforms specified in entry 9C110.

name: 1B102
description: Metal powder "production equipment", other than that specified in 1B002, and components as follows:

name: 1B102.a.
description: Metal powder "production equipment" usable for the "production", in a controlled environment, of spherical, spheroidal or atomised materials specified in 1C011.a., 1C011.b., 1C111.a.1., 1C111.a.2. or in the Military Goods Controls.

name: 1B102.b.
description: Specially designed components for "production equipment" specified in 1B002 or 1B102.a.

name: 1B115
description: Equipment, other than that specified in 1B002 or 1B102, for the production of propellant and propellant constituents, as follows, and specially designed components therefor:

name: 1B115.a.
description: "Production equipment" for the "production", handling or acceptance testing of liquid propellants or propellant constituents specified in 1C011.a., 1C011.b., 1C111 or in the Military Goods Controls;

name: 1B115.b.
description: "Production equipment" for the "production", handling, mixing, curing, casting, pressing, machining, extruding or acceptance testing of solid propellants or propellant constituents specified in 1C011.a., 1C011.b., 1C111 or in the Military Goods Controls.

name: 1B116
description: Specially designed nozzles for producing pyrolitically derived materials formed on a mould, mandrel or other substrate from precursor gases which decompose in the 1 573 K (1 300 °C) to 3 173 K (2 900 °C) temperature range at pressures of 130 Pa to 20 kPa.

description: Batch mixers having all of the following, and specially designed components therefor: a. Designed or modified for mixing under vacuum in the range of zero to 13,326 kPa: b. Capable of controlling the temperature of the mixing chamber; c. A total volumetric capacity of 110 litres or more; and d. At least one ‘mixing/kneading shaft’ mounted off centre.

name: 1B118
description: Continuous mixers having all of the following, and specially designed components therefor: a. Designed or modified for mixing under vacuum in the range of zero to 13,326 kPa; b. Capable of controlling the temperature of the mixing chamber; c. any of the following: 1. Two or more mixing/kneading shafts; or 2. All of the following: a. A single rotating and oscillating shaft with kneading teeth/pins; and b. Kneading teeth/pins inside the casing of the mixing chamber.

name: 1B119
description: Fluid energy mills usable for grinding or milling substances specified in 1C011.a., 1C011.b., 1C111 or in the Military Goods Controls, and specially designed components therefor.

name: 1B201
description: Filament winding machines, other than those specified in 1B001 or 1B101, and related equipment, as follows:

name: 1B201.a.
description: Filament winding machines having all of the following characteristics: 1. Having motions for positioning, wrapping, and winding fibres coordinated and programmed in two or more axes; 2. Specially designed to fabricate composite structures or laminates from "fibrous or filamentary materials"; and 3. Capable of winding cylindrical tubes with an internal diameter between 75 and 650 mm and lengths of 300 mm or greater;

name: 1B201.b.
description: Coordinating and programming controls for the filament winding machines specified in 1B201.a.;

name: 1B201.c.
description: Precision mandrels for the filament winding machines specified in 1B201.a.

name: 1B225
description: Electrolytic cells for fluorine production with an output capacity greater than 250 g of fluorine per hour.

name: 1B226
description: Electromagnetic isotope separators designed for, or equipped with, single or multiple ion sources capable of providing a total ion beam current of 50 mA or greater.

name: 1B228
description: Hydrogen cryogenic distillation columns having all of the following characteristics: a. Designed for operation with internal temperatures in the range of 15 K (-258°C) to 35 K ( 238°C); b. Designed for operation at internal pressures in the range of 0.1 MPa to 1 MPa; c. Constructed of either:  1. Austenitic stainless steel; or  2. Equivalent materials which are both cryogenic and hydrogen (H2)-compatible between 15 K (-258°C) and 35 K (-238°C); and d. With internal diameters of 30 cm or greater and "effective lengths" of 4 m or greater.

name: 1B230
description: Pumps capable of circulating solutions of concentrated or dilute potassium amide catalyst in liquid ammonia (KNH2/NH3), having all of the following characteristics: a. Airtight (i.e., hermetically sealed); b. A capacity greater than 8,5 m^3/h; and c. Either of the following characteristics: 1. For concentrated potassium amide solutions (1 % or greater), an operating pressure of 1,5 to 60 MPa; or 2. For dilute potassium amide solutions (less than 1 %), an operating pressure of 20 to 60 MPa.

name: 1B231
description: Tritium facilities or plants, and equipment therefor, as follows:

description: Facilities or plants for the production, recovery, extraction, concentration, or handling of tritium;

name: 1B231.b.

name: 1B231.b.1.
description: Hydrogen or helium refrigeration units capable of cooling to 23 K (– 250 °C) or less, with heat removal capacity greater than 150 W;

name: 1B231.b.2.
description: Hydrogen isotope storage or hydrogen isotope purification systems using metal hydrides as the storage or purification medium.

name: 1B232
description: Turboexpanders or turboexpander-compressor sets having both of the following characteristics: a. Designed for operation with an outlet temperature of 35 K (– 238 °C) or less; and b. Designed for a throughput of hydrogen gas of 1 000 kg/h or greater.

description: Facilities or plants for the separation of lithium isotopes;

description: Packed liquid-liquid exchange columns specially designed for lithium amalgams;

description: Mercury or lithium amalgam pumps;

description: Lithium amalgam electrolysis cells;

description: Evaporators for concentrated lithium hydroxide solution;

name: 1B233.c.
description: Ion exchange systems specially designed for lithium isotope separation, and specially designed components therefor;

name: 1B233.d.
description: Chemical exchange systems (employing crown ethers, cryptands, or lariat ethers), specially designed for lithium isotope separation, and specially designed components therefor.

name: 1B234
description: High explosive containment vessels, chambers, containers and other similar containment devices designed for the testing of high explosives or explosive devices and having both of the following characteristics: a. Designed to fully contain an explosion equivalent to 2 kg of trinitrotoluene (TNT) or greater; and b. Having design elements or features enabling real time or delayed transfer of diagnostic or measurement information.

name: 1B235
description: Target assemblies and components for the production of tritium as follows:

name: 1B235.a.
description: Target assemblies made of or containing lithium enriched in the lithium-6 isotope specially designed for the production of tritium through irradiation, including insertion in a nuclear reactor;

name: 1B235.b.
description: Components specially designed for the target assemblies specified in 1B235.a.

name: 1C
description: Materials

name: 1C001
description: Materials specially designed for absorbing electromagnetic radiation, or intrinsically conductive polymers, as follows:

name: 1C001.a.
description: Materials for absorbing frequencies exceeding 2 × 10^8 Hz but less than 3 × 10^12 Hz;

name: 1C001.b.
description: Materials not transparent to visible light and specially designed for absorbing near-infrared radiation having a wavelength exceeding 810 nm but less than 2 000 nm (frequencies exceeding 150 THz but less than 370 THz);

name: 1C001.c.
description: Intrinsically conductive polymeric materials with a ‘bulk electrical conductivity’ exceeding 10 000 S/m (Siemens per metre) or a ‘sheet (surface) resistivity’ of less than 100 ohms/square, based on any of the following polymers:

name: 1C001.c.1.
description: Polyaniline;

name: 1C001.c.2.
description: Polypyrrole;

name: 1C001.c.3.
description: Polythiophene;

name: 1C001.c.4.
description: Poly phenylene-vinylene; or

description: Poly thienylene-vinylene.

description: Metal alloys, metal alloy powder and alloyed materials, as follows:

name: 1C002.a.
description: Aluminides, as follows:

name: 1C002.a.1.
description: Nickel aluminides containing a minimum of 15 % by weight aluminium, a maximum of 38 % by weight aluminium and at least one additional alloying element;

name: 1C002.a.2.
description: Titanium aluminides containing 10 % by weight or more aluminium and at least one additional alloying element;

name: 1C002.b.
description: Metal alloys, as follows, made from the powder or particulate material specified in 1C002.c.:

name: 1C002.b.1.
description: Nickel alloys having any of the following:

name: 1C002.b.1.a.
description: A ‘stress-rupture life’ of 10 000 hours or longer at 923 K (650 °C) at a stress of 676 MPa; or

name: 1C002.b.1.b.
description: A ‘low cycle fatigue life’ of 10 000 cycles or more at 823 K (550 °C) at a maximum stress of 1 095 MPa;

name: 1C002.b.2.
description: Niobium alloys having any of the following:

description: A ‘stress-rupture life’ of 10 000 hours or longer at 1 073 K (800 °C) at a stress of 400 MPa; or

description: A ‘low cycle fatigue life’ of 10 000 cycles or more at 973 K (700 °C) at a maximum stress of 700 MPa;

name: 1C002.b.3.
description: Titanium alloys having any of the following:

description: A ‘stress-rupture life’ of 10 000 hours or longer at 723 K (450 °C) at a stress of 200 MPa; or

name: 1C002.b.3.b.
description: A ‘low cycle fatigue life’ of 10 000 cycles or more at 723 K (450 °C) at a maximum stress of 400 MPa;

name: 1C002.b.4.
description: Aluminium alloys having any of the following:

name: 1C002.b.4.a.
description: A tensile strength of 240 MPa or more at 473 K (200 °C); or

name: 1C002.b.4.b.
description: A tensile strength of 415 MPa or more at 298 K (25 °C);

name: 1C002.b.5.
description: Magnesium alloys having all of the following: a. A tensile strength of 345 MPa or more; and b. A corrosion rate of less than 1 mm/year in 3 % sodium chloride aqueous solution measured in accordance with ASTM standard G-31 or national equivalents;

name: 1C002.c.
description: Metal alloy powder or particulate material, having all of the following: 1. Made from any of the following composition systems: a. Nickel alloys (Ni-Al-X, Ni-X-Al) qualified for turbine engine parts or components, i.e. with less than 3 non-metallic particles (introduced during the manufacturing process) larger than 100 μm in 109 alloy particles; b. Niobium alloys (Nb-Al-X or Nb-X-Al, Nb-Si-X or Nb-X-Si, Nb-Ti-X or Nb-X-Ti); c. Titanium alloys (Ti-Al-X or Ti-X-Al); d. Aluminium alloys (Al-Mg-X or Al-X-Mg, Al-Zn-X or Al-X-Zn, Al-Fe-X or Al-X-Fe); or e. Magnesium alloys (Mg-Al-X or Mg-X-Al); 2. Made in a controlled environment by any of the following processes: a. ‘Vacuum atomisation’; b. ‘Gas atomisation’; c. ‘Rotary atomisation’; d. ‘Splat quenching’; e. ‘Melt spinning’ and ‘comminution’; f. ‘Melt extraction’ and ‘comminution’; g. ‘Mechanical alloying’; or h. ‘Plasma atomisation’; and 3. Capable of forming materials specified in 1C002.a. or 1C002.b.;

description: Alloyed materials having all of the following: 1. Made from any of the composition systems specified in 1C002.c.1.; 2. In the form of uncomminuted flakes, ribbons or thin rods; and 3. Produced in a controlled environment by any of the following: a. ‘Splat quenching’; b. ‘Melt spinning’; or c. ‘Melt extraction’.

description: Magnetic metals, of all types and of whatever form, having any of the following:

description: Initial relative permeability of 120 000 or more and a thickness of 0,05 mm or less;

description: Magnetostrictive alloys having any of the following:

name: 1C003.b.1.
description: A saturation magnetostriction of more than 5 × 10^–4; or

description: A magnetomechanical coupling factor (k) of more than 0,8; or

name: 1C005.a.
description: "Superconductive""composite" conductors containing one or more niobium-titanium ‘filaments’, having all of the following: 1. Embedded in a "matrix" other than a copper or copper-based mixed "matrix"; and 2. Having a cross-section area less than 0,28 × 10-4 mm^2 (6 μm in diameter for circular ‘filaments’);

name: 1C005.b.
description: "Superconductive""composite" conductors consisting of one or more "superconductive"‘filaments’ other than niobium-titanium, having all of the following: 1. name: 1C005.c.
description: "Superconductive""composite" conductors consisting of one or more "superconductive"‘filaments’ which remain "superconductive" above 115 K (– 158,16 °C).

Polybromotrifluoroethylene;

name: 1C006.d.
description: Fluorocarbon fluids designed for electronic cooling and having all of the following: 1. Containing 85 % by weight or more of any of the following, or mixtures thereof: a. Monomeric forms of perfluoropolyalkylether-triazines or perfluoroaliphatic-ethers; b. Perfluoroalkylamines; c. Perfluorocycloalkanes; or d. Perfluoroalkanes; 2. Density at 298 K (25 °C) of 1,5 g/ml or more; 3. In a liquid state at 273 K (0 °C); and 4. Containing 60 % or more by weight of fluorine.

description: Ceramic powders of titanium diboride (TiB2) (CAS 12045-63-5) having total metallic impurities, excluding intentional additions, of less than 5 000 ppm, an average particle size equal to or less than 5 μm and no more than 10 % of the particles larger than 10 μm;

name: 1C007.b.
description: Not used;

name: 1C007.c.
description: Ceramic-"matrix""composite" materials as follows:

description: Ceramic-ceramic "composite" materials with a glass or oxide-"matrix" and reinforced with any of the following:

description: Continuous fibres made from any of the following materials:

description: Si-C-N; or

description: Not used;

name: 1C007.f.

name: 6A002.a.1.b.
description: "Space-qualified" solid-state detectors having all of the following: 1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 900 nm but not exceeding 1 200 nm; and 2. A response "time constant" of 95 ns or less;

Electron image amplification using any of the following: a. A microchannel plate with a hole pitch (centre-to-centre spacing) of 12 μm or less; or b. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, specially designed or modified to achieve "charge multiplication" other than by a microchannel plate; and 3. "III/V compound" semiconductor (e.g., GaAs or GaInAs) photocathodes and transferred electron photocathodes, having a maximum "radiant sensitivity" exceeding 15 mA/W;

name: 6A002.a.2.c.

description: Microchannel plates having a hole pitch (centre-to-centre spacing) of 12 μm or less;

name: 9E003.e.

An overall power output of more than 750 kW based on 80/1269/EEC, ISO 2534 or national equivalents; and 3. Power density of more than 700 kW/m^3 of ‘box volume’;

name: 9E003.f.
description: "Technology" "required" for the "production" of specially designed components for "high output diesel engines", as follows:

name: 9E003.f.1.
description: "Technology""required" for the "production" of engine systems having all of the following components employing ceramics materials specified in 1C007: a. Cylinder liners; b. Pistons; c. Cylinder heads; and d. One or more other components (including exhaust ports, turbochargers, valve guides, valve assemblies or insulated fuel injectors);

name: 9E003.f.2.
description: "Technology""required" for the "production" of turbocharger systems with single-stage compressors and having all of the following: a. Operating at pressure ratios of 4:1 or higher; b. Mass flow in the range from 30 to 130 kg per minute; and c. Variable flow area capability within the compressor or turbine sections;

name: 9E003.f.3.
description: "Technology""required" for the "production" of fuel injection systems with a specially designed multifuel (e.g., diesel or jet fuel) capability covering a viscosity range from diesel fuel (2,5 cSt at 310,8 K (37,8 °C)) down to gasoline fuel (0,5 cSt at 310,8 K (37,8 °C)) and having all of the following: a. Injection amount in excess of 230 mm3 per injection per cylinder; and b. Electronic control features specially designed for switching governor characteristics automatically depending on fuel property to provide the same torque characteristics by using the appropriate sensors;

name: 9E003.g.
description: "Technology" "required" for the "development" or "production" of "high output diesel engines" for solid, gas phase or liquid film (or combinations thereof) cylinder wall lubrication and permitting operation to temperatures exceeding 723 K (450°C), measured on the cylinder wall at the top limit of travel of the top ring of the piston;

name: 9E003.h.
description: "Technology" for gas turbine engine "FADEC systems" as follows:

name: 9E003.h.1.
description: "Development""technology" for deriving the functional requirements for the components necessary for the "FADEC system" to regulate engine thrust or shaft power (e.g., feedback sensor time constants and accuracies, fuel valve slew rate);

name: 9E003.h.2.
description: "Development" or "production""technology" for control and diagnostic components unique to the "FADEC system" and used to regulate engine thrust or shaft power;

name: 9E003.h.3.
description: "Development""technology" for the control law algorithms, including "source code", unique to the "FADEC system" and used to regulate engine thrust or shaft power;

name: 9E003.i.
description: "Technology" for adjustable flow path systems designed to maintain engine stability for gas generator turbines, fan or power turbines, or propelling nozzles, as follows:

name: 9E003.i.1.
description: "Development""technology" for deriving the functional requirements for the components that maintain engine stability;

name: 9E003.i.2.
description: "Development" or "production""technology" for components unique to the adjustable flow path system and that maintain engine stability;

name: 9E003.i.3.
description: "Development""technology" for the control law algorithms, including "source code", unique to the adjustable flow path system and that maintain engine stability.

name: 9E003.j.
description: "Technology""required" for the "development" of wing-folding systems designed for fixed-wing "aircraft" powered by gas turbine engines;

name: 9E003.k.
description: "Technology", not specified in 9E003.a., 9E003.h., or 900E.3.i., "required" for the "development" of any of the following components or systems, specially designed for aero gas turbine engines to enable "aircraft" to cruise at Mach 1 or greater for more than 30 minutes:

name: 9E003.k.1.
description: Propulsion inlet systems;

name: 9E003.k.2.
description: Propulsion exhaust systems;

name: 9E003.k.3.
description: "Reheat systems";

name: 9E003.k.4.
description: "Active thermal management systems" to condition fluids used to lubricate or cool "engine rotor supports";

name: 9E003.k.5.
description: Oil-free "engine rotor supports"; or

name: 9E003.k.6.
description: Systems to remove heat from "compression system" core gas path flow.

name: 9E101.
description: “Technology” as follows:

name: 9E101.a.
description: "Technology" according to the General Technology Note for the "development" of goods specified in 9A101, 9A102, 9A104 to 9A111, 9A112.a. or 9A115 to 9A121.

name: 9E101.b.
description: "Technology" according to the General Technology Note for the "production" of "UAV`s specified in 9A012 or goods specified in 9A101, 9A102, 9A104 to 9A111, 9A112.a. or 9A115 to 9A121.

name: 9E102
description: "Technology" according to the General Technology Note for the "use" of space launch vehicles specified in 9A004, goods specified in 9A005 to 9A011, "UAV`s specified in 9A012 or goods specified in 9A101, 9A102, 9A104 to 9A111, 9A112.a., 9A115 to 9A121, 9B105, 9B106, 9B115, 9B116, 9B117, 9D101 or 9D103.
